questions.q: In what is commonly known as the Great Commission (Matthew 28:19-20), what command did Jesus give to His followers just before His ascension?
options: To go into the wilderness and fast for forty days
To build magnificent temples in His name across the world
To stay in Jerusalem permanently to protect the temple
To go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing and teaching them
questions.explain: Jesus explicitly commanded: "Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you."

questions.q: According to Luke 24:50-51, where did Jesus lead His disciples just before He lifted up His hands, blessed them, and ascended into heaven?
questions.explain: Luke 24:50 states, "Then he led them out as far as Bethany, and lifting up his hands he blessed them. While he blessed them, he parted from them and was carried up into heaven."

questions.q: According to Mark 16:17-18, Jesus listed several miraculous signs that would accompany those who believe. Which of the following is **NOT** one of those signs?
options: They will cast out demons in His name.
They will speak in new tongues.
They will become rich and politically powerful on earth.
They will lay their hands on the sick, and they will recover.
questions.explain: The signs Jesus mentioned included casting out demons, speaking in tongues, picking up serpents, drinking deadly poison without harm, and healing the sick. Wealth and political power were not promised as signs of belief.
